I'm a first-year student in the [Master of Business Analytics](https://www.monash.edu/business/master-of-business-analytics) at Monash University, coming to data from a slightly unusual path.

I spent four years as a civil engineer and the last four advising property investors with [PropNex Singapore](https://www.propnex.com/). Most people in the industry approach it as sales, but I found myself drawn to the data side of things, and that's where I found my style. I compare developments, look at the numbers behind supply and demand, and help clients decide whether to buy, sell or hold, and how to optimise their portfolios. A big part of the job is turning those numbers into something clients can easily understand and act on. The more I worked with data, the more I wanted the technical skills to do it properly, and that's what brought me to analytics.

These days I'm learning to explore, analyse and visualise data in R, and this site is where I share what I'm working on.
